title: Kleros decentralized arbitration
description: Off-chain dispute resolution via Kleros, the decentralized juror court. Selects a Kleros subcourt and a minimum juror count for any dispute escalated from this order. This clause covers one specific arbitration provider; sister `figaro-arbitration-<provider>-v1` clauses would cover other decentralized ODR providers as they integrate with Figaro. Compose with `figaro-applicable-law-v1` to add a state-law / ADR recourse layer.

fields.name: klerosCourt
fields.description: Kleros subcourt, encoded position-as-index: general = 0 (catch-all, the default); blockchain-nontechnical = 1 / blockchain-technical = 2 (on-chain-agreement disputes); english-language = 3 (disputes hinging on English-language interpretation). To pre-agree no specific forum, omit this whole clause — there is no placeholder court to select.

fields.name: klerosMinJurors
fields.description: Minimum jurors for the Kleros subcourt. Kleros default is 3.
